rv.q: Kenrex grips like a true-crime podcast.
Jack Holden is thrilling in this monodrama of American small-town horror
It's style and substance; a thrilling story told in an exhilarating way.
'Kenrex' blew in like a storm this October and over the course of two hours, it left its audience awestruck and amazed.
But whatever the moral takeaways from the story, KENREX is predominantly a jaw-droppingly effective thriller, as Our Town turns into Fuente Ovejuna .
